biology.context.0: This does not establish physiological equivalence by species.
biology.context.1: Abstract claustral budget; it does not represent grams of fat/protein.
biology.context.2: Accelerated internal progress; these are not incubation days.
biology.context.3: This version does not distinguish species with and without cocoons.
biology.context.4: Range received for investigation; it does not change timers.
biology.context.5: Lasius niger; general incubator condition. Experiment-specific variations and samples are in Table S1.
biology.context.6: 17/22 survivors within 93 days; initial cohort of 24. This is not a universal founding timeline.
biology.context.7: Only revisions with separate reserves. Abstract available credits, not body mass or calorimetry.
biology.context.8: Transported soil plug in revision 3; porous diffusion and reduced flow, without calibrated thermal or air-humidity insulation.
biology.context.9: Revision 4: accelerated model days. Local temperature and pore water, which is not equivalent to chamber relative air humidity. Ranges received from another AI remain inactive hypotheses.
biology.context.10: Seasonal reproductive memory. Accelerated model days, without reproducing the laboratory protocol.
biology.context.11: Willot et al. studied five temperate species. These conditions are for reference only; the demonstration does not reproduce the experiment.
biology.context.12: Queen foraging using local sensors, limited load and finite outside food separate from maternal reserves.
biology.context.13: Shallow local probing and memory of visited chambers. Pore water is not relative air humidity. Geometry does not guarantee future conditions.
biology.context.14: Food by chamber, preferences based on visits and spoilage at the pile location. Pore water is not chamber relative air humidity.
biology.context.15: Clay and compaction change transport and relative ceiling capacity; fixed volumetric porosity and conserved soil volume. This is not a geotechnical test.
biology.context.16: Received balance = viable + used + lost. Females have a paternal copy from a recorded male; unfertilized eggs are haploid males in this demonstration profile.
biology.context.17: Age and disease hazards are separate from energy, injuries, infertility and predation. The scale is neither a maximum age nor a measured natural life expectancy.
biology.unit.26: fraction per 100 steps and excess water
biology.uncertainty.1: Species, sample and dispersion not verified
biology.uncertainty.2: Rearing condition, not an estimated optimum
biology.uncertainty.6: Demonstration choice not fitted to a species, stage or natural population.
biology.uncertainty.7: Demonstration coefficient; not a species fit.
biology.uncertainty.8: Experimental condition, not a universal optimum; individual samples were not extracted.
biology.uncertainty.9: Demonstration choice, without calibrated species or diet.
biology.uncertainty.10: Demonstration preference, without calibrated species or chamber microclimate.
biology.uncertainty.11: Demonstration credits and preferred moisture; no calibrated diet or fungus.
biology.uncertainty.12: Normalized exploratory choice; no experimentally fitted density, texture or strength.
biology.uncertainty.13: No species-calibrated capacity, sperm senescence or polyandry frequency.
biology.uncertainty.14: Curve and rates chosen for investigation; no species-specific survival or disease fitting.
biology.preset: Only the reference profile’s initial climate.
